lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都灰了
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass turns grey

lines.zh: 我的长裙扫过地面，留下湿痕
lines.en: My long skirt drags a wet trail
One stride clears the field ridge
That thing in your coat is moving.
The smell of the sea walks with me

lines.zh: 我的手指划过空气，留下纹
lines.en: My fingers trace lines in the air

lines.zh: 我在田野上投下一道长影
lines.en: I cast a long shadow over the field

lines.zh: 我停在一处，地面就凉了
lines.en: I pause, and the ground turns cold

lines.zh: 我走过去，蒲公英都垂了
lines.en: I pass and the dandelions bow
My hair drifts, though there's no wind

lines.zh: 我站着，好像在看很远的地方
lines.en: I stand as if watching something far away
My hem soaks in the shallows

lines.zh: 我抬起手，像在测量什么
lines.en: I raise a hand as if measuring something
It's quiet, and the quiet is wrong
My breath makes the air briny
I look down at this hand of mine
An iron golem far off has stopped

lines.zh: 我的影子比我的身体慢一拍
lines.en: My shadow lags a beat behind me
I hum a short passage
Sea fog rises from my feet
I don't blink, and needn't
I wait, and my waiting is patient
The daylight dims a little

lines.zh: 我让它沉进裙底的潮气。
lines.en: I let it sink into the damp beneath my skirts.
The water sounds like breathing

lines.zh: 我数着海里有什么在动
lines.en: I count what moves in the sea
You look up at me, only to my waist

lines.zh: 我低头，我的眼睛是海的颜色
lines.en: I look down, my eyes the color of the sea

lines.zh: 你身上有我熟悉的味道
lines.en: You carry a scent I know
You stand very steady; that's rare

lines.zh: 我走一步，你的影子就短了
lines.en: I take a step and your shadow shortens
I'm patient; I've been waiting

lines.zh: 我压着声音说话，地面在震
lines.en: I speak low and the ground trembles
You hear the water too, don't you
You grip your weapon; I see
I smile at you once

lines.zh: 我靠近一点，你就更冷了
lines.en: I come closer and you grow colder
I wait for you to speak first
I step back and the water withdraws
A corner of my hem is torn

lines.zh: 我抬起头，眼里有东西在动
lines.en: I raise my head and something moves in my eyes
Seawater seeps from the wound
I press my chest; my breathing breaks
I murmur one phrase
I stay motionless a long while
The fog thins around me
I retreat, but don't turn my back
I stare at you, terribly quiet
You carry something from the sea
I know that smell

lines.zh: 你把组织拿在手里，太天真
lines.en: You hold that tissue in your hand; naive
It's still moving in your hand
Eat it and you'll hear the sea
You've stepped back three paces; good
It isn't the meat I want

lines.zh: 我抬起手指，让雾绕上来。
lines.en: I lift my fingers and let the mist curl up.
Set it on the ground
You think that's food

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞上礁石
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a reef
I push and you slide far

lines.zh: 我的手按住你的肩，很冷
lines.en: My hand settles on your shoulder, cold
You retreat and the water spreads from my feet

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，空气变湿
lines.en: We collide and the air turns damp

lines.zh: 我的裙摆绕住了你的脚
lines.en: My hem tangles your feet
The blow sways my skirts
You squeeze past my skirt

lines.zh: 这一下把我推偏了半步
lines.en: That shove moves me half a step

lines.zh: 你站在我投下的影子里
lines.en: You stand inside my shadow

lines.zh: 海里有另一个声音回应我
lines.en: Another voice answers from the sea
It is deeper than I am, and quieter
We stand together on the water's face
Its hem is longer than mine
We raise our hands together
The sea fog wraps us both
Everything on the shore has drawn back
Sound passes back and forth between us
Neither of us speaks

lines.zh: 这一片海以后属于两个
lines.en: Two now share this sea
I bend and take it up
It grows lighter in my hand
I hold it up to the light
It bears the sea's grain
I wash it in the water
It softens, as if alive

lines.zh: 我走过去，路面自己湿了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the ground turns wet.
This thing must be kept
I lay it on the reef
You'd best not touch it
Iron things; I hate them
It moved; I saw it
I raise my hand and the sea rises
You've retreated too late
The water is near here; convenient
I don't run; I never run
I have you locked
The sea fog is thickening
The people here should withdraw
I go over, a step at a time
Water drips from my cuff
The sky darkens, and it isn't cloud
You've raised your weapon; good
I've waited a long time for this
Don't count on high ground
The sea will follow me up
I lower my voice
Everything you hear now is me

lines.zh: 我抬手指向天，雾就压下来
lines.en: I point skyward and the fog descends

lines.zh: 水从我脚下一直漫到你的鞋
lines.en: Water spreads from my feet to your boots
I'm not fast; my shadow is

lines.zh: 你退到坡上，我还在下面
lines.en: You retreat uphill; I stay below
I speak names from the sea
Those names tighten the air
Are your ears bleeding

lines.zh: 我每一步都让地面湿透
lines.en: Every step soaks the ground
I see you looking for a way out
The ring of iron is nearby

lines.zh: 我不需要靠近就能碰到你
lines.en: I can reach you without closing in
The sea rises behind me
Don't run toward the water
That will only be quicker
I raise my hand to chest height
Your chest rises less and less
I'm counting your steps in the mud
All of this ring is my water
Listen; the sea is calling me
I'm not ready to end this

lines.zh: 我的手按下来，你整个人下沉
lines.en: My hand comes down and you sink

lines.zh: 这一下把地面压出裂纹
lines.en: The blow cracks the ground

lines.zh: 我的袖子里伸出东西缠住你
lines.en: Something reaches from my sleeve and binds you

lines.zh: 你被推得滑出去，脚在土里划痕
lines.en: You slide away, boots gouging the dirt

lines.zh: 我抬手，水墙从侧面撞来
lines.en: I raise a hand and a wall of water strikes

lines.zh: 你挡了，手臂上结了盐霜
lines.en: You block and salt crusts your arm

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，我还没认真
lines.en: That was light; I'm not trying yet
I seize your bracer
You tear free, leaving a layer of skin
I press you into the shallow water
You choke once; the seawater is bitter
I step back and watch you rise

lines.zh: 我的手掌翻过来，从下往上
lines.en: My palm turns and comes from below
The blow puts you on your knees
The sea's surface swells first
The water recedes and I'm standing there

lines.zh: 浓雾从岸边一直推到内陆
lines.en: Fog pushes inland from the shore

lines.zh: 我的裙摆先落在干地上
lines.en: My hem touches dry land first
Something has blocked the daylight

lines.zh: 我抬起头，比你见过的都高
lines.en: I raise my head, taller than anything you've seen

lines.zh: 海腥味一下子铺满整片地
lines.en: The smell of the sea floods the land
I come ashore step by step

lines.zh: 海底的声音跟着我上来
lines.en: The sounds of the seabed come up with me

lines.zh: 我停住，四周的水都静了
lines.en: I stop, and the water around us goes still
I raise a hand and the wind turns
The quiet sea answers to me.
The grass on the shore starts to grey
There's the smell of iron; I caught it
I slowly spread my fingers
I look out over this land
I've come, and the sea came with me

lines.zh: 水在我的脚下找到了路
lines.en: Water finds its way beneath my feet

lines.zh: 远处的水鸟全都不见了
lines.en: Every seabird far off is gone
I move more quietly than sound

lines.zh: 火靠近我，水汽扑了满地
lines.en: Fire nears me and steam floods the ground

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，砸出一片水洼
lines.en: I fall from height and crater a pool

lines.zh: 水本该听我的，它却灌进我
lines.en: Water should obey me, yet it fills me
The blast tears my skirt

lines.zh: 箭插进我的肩，像一根刺
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder like a thorn

lines.zh: 那股力量碰了我，我也退了
lines.en: That force touches me, and I too retreat

lines.zh: 我太久没有进食，身子轻了
lines.en: Too long without feeding; I feel thin

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，被我的水引走了一半
lines.en: Lightning falls and my water takes half of it

lines.zh: 这里没有海，我踩不到底
lines.en: There's no sea here; my feet find nothing
